title: Missing Environment Variable in Globex Deployment
text:
Symptom: Globex service startup fails with 'KeyError: \'<VAR_NAME>\'' (Python) or 'Error: Environment variable <VAR_NAME> is required but not set'. Health check fails immediately after deploy. Kubernetes pod enters CrashLoopBackOff.

Root Cause: New environment variable added to code but not provisioned in Kubernetes Secret or ConfigMap; staging environment missing a variable that exists in production; variable renamed in a refactor but old name still referenced.

Diagnosis Steps:
1. Check the CrashLoopBackOff logs: 'kubectl logs <pod> -n globex-prod --previous'
2. List currently set env vars in running pod: 'kubectl exec <pod> -- env | sort'
3. Compare against .env.example or Globex environment manifest at infra/k8s/envs/
4. Check if the variable exists in the correct namespace Secret: 'kubectl get secret globex-app-secrets -o yaml'

Fix:
- Add missing variable to Kubernetes Secret: 'kubectl create secret generic globex-app-secrets --from-literal=<VAR>=<VALUE> --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -'
- For ConfigMap (non-sensitive): edit infra/k8s/envs/configmap.yaml and apply
- Globex AWS ECS: add via AWS Console > ECS > Task Definition > Environment Variables or update Terraform
- Rollback: if urgent, roll back to previous deployment: 'kubectl rollout undo deployment/globex-api -n globex-prod'

Globex Required Variables: GLOBEX_DB_URL, GLOBEX_REDIS_CLUSTER, GLOBEX_KAFKA_BROKERS, GLOBEX_S3_BUCKET, GLOBEX_VAULT_ADDR.

Prevention: Use globex-config-validator pre-deploy hook; document all variables in infra/k8s/envs/README.md.
